translations.web: He threw down the pieces of silver in the sanctuary, and departed. He went away and hanged himself.
translations.bsb: So Judas threw the silver into the temple and left. Then he went away and hanged himself.
translations.kjv: And he cast down the pieces of silver in the temple, and departed, and went and hanged himself.
translations.asv: And he cast down the pieces of silver into the sanctuary, and departed; and he went away and hanged himself.
